judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is an h4 'Tópicos' ('Topics') placed after the article body. In the snapshot, the screenshot and the live HTML (unchanged on 2026-10-24), the only content under it is a rel="tag" link 'Dasa Educa', which is the topic or category tag the article is filed under; the next heading, 'Compartilhar', starts the share buttons. A heading reading 'Topics' over a list of the article's topic tags describes exactly what that section is for, and 2.4.6 asks only that headings describe topic or purpose, not that they be long or specific. The heading is short but accurate, so this is not a failure of 2.4.6. The checker had the surrounding text ('Tópicos Dasa Educa Compartilhar') and still judged it wrongly.
